questions.label: Owned by the institution since Jan 1, 2024

findings.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Orange bought the Alton Avenue property in November 2002 and still holds the roughly 8-acre remainder as the Christ Our Savior parish campus; a separate portion sold in 2017 is now housing. County deed and assessor records tying the APN to the Diocese were not checked, so the exact title holder is unconfirmed.
